Create, list and revoke the proxy tokens that identify an account on each request

Usage: byrle token <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create  Create a token and print it on stdout. It is shown once
  revoke  Revoke a token
  list    List tokens, without the tokens themselves
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
